map.：累计 −1000→−700→−300→+200，第 3 年回正，回收期 = 2: Cumulative -1000 -> -700 -> -300 -> +200, turning positive in year 3, so the payback period = 2 + 300/500 = 2.6 years.
map.：累计现金流依次为 −1000、−600、−200、+200、+400，在第 2: Cumulative cash flow goes -1000, -600, -200, +200, +400, turning positive between periods 2 and 3; the interpolated payback period = 2 + 200/400 = 2.50 years, and the 200 in period 5 does not affect when payback occurs.

map.回收期短就好？: Is a shorter payback always better?
map.短回收期降风险但忽略回本后现金流；高回报长周期项目可能被误筛掉，需结合 NPV。: A short payback lowers risk but ignores cash flow after payback; high-return long-cycle projects may be screened out by mistake, so combine it with NPV.
map.回收期为什么不能单独用于决策？: Why can't payback period be used alone for decisions?
map.它既忽略回收期之后的现金流，也不考虑资金的时间价值。一个 2.5 年回本但之后毫: It ignores both cash flow after the payback period and the time value of money. A project that pays back in 2.5 years with nothing afterwards can be worse than one that pays back in 4 years with rich long-term cash flow, so it must be used together with NPV and IRR.
